sections.heading: Saved context
sections.text: Your question, selected measures and view are saved. Reopening refreshes the evidence and highlights what changed.

sections.heading: Coverage
sections.text: Coverage counts measures that qualify for this view. It is not confidence or risk. Missing, stale and excluded observations do not become zero.

sections.heading: Sources and times
sections.text: Each measure keeps its own source, observation time and freshness rule. Open its evidence entry for details.

sections.heading: Research actions
sections.text: Saving or reopening research does not start a monitor, alert or trade. Those actions require their own explicit request.

sections.heading: 保存的内容
sections.text: 保存问题、已选指标和当前视图。重新打开时会刷新证据并显示变化。

sections.heading: 证据覆盖
sections.text: 覆盖比例统计符合当前视图条件的指标，不代表信心或风险。缺失、过期和排除的数据不会视为零。

sections.heading: 来源与时间
sections.text: 每项指标保留自己的来源、观察时间和时效规则。可打开该项证据查看详情。

sections.heading: 研究操作
sections.text: 保存或打开研究不会启动监控、提醒或交易。这些操作需要单独明确发起。

sections.heading: Absolute rate gap
sections.text: Compare the distance between two nominal policy settings at the selected start and end dates. Absolute gap in basis points = |Japan rate − US rate| × 100 when rates are expressed in percent. Change = end gap − start gap. A negative change means the gap narrowed.

sections.heading: Signed gap
sections.text: The signed Japan − US gap is separate. In this example it moves from −3.00 to −2.50 percentage points while the absolute gap narrows from 300 to 250 basis points.

sections.heading: Qualified observations
sections.text: Both economies need comparable instruments and units with accepted observations at both date cutoffs and permitted source access. Missing, stale, denied or misaligned inputs make the comparison unavailable. A target range is not silently replaced by its midpoint.

sections.heading: Scope and units
sections.text: This view compares nominal settings. Expected paths and real rates use separate methods. Rates stay in percentages; your USD display preference does not convert them.

sections.heading: Saved baseline
sections.text: A new pair and date window has no matching saved baseline. A change across selected dates is not a change since saving. The original evidence references remain intact.

sections.heading: Source example
sections.text: The displayed A/B series and four observations are illustrative. The live evidence ledger must identify the actual instruments, sources, observation and release dates.

preservedContracts: Retain all research questions, numbers, selected measures, source timestamps, source actions, status distinctions and saved/draft state. Do not reclassify missing or excluded observations as zero.

Authenticated inventory: loading is distinct from empty; signed-out is distinct from failure; do not show an old inventory as current. Return restores market, period, currency, query, filters, selected measures, scroll, focus and return target.

Save/remove/undo: bind the existing authenticated owner, record identity, expected version and original request identity. Pending or uncertain outcomes require original-target reconciliation; no duplicate writes. Confirmed no-record failure alone permits the specified retry. Success requires an authoritative receipt and semantic readback.

Undo is a conditional separate write affecting the exact record/settings once. Do not overwrite later edits or delete another question. Keep acknowledged outcome distinct from newer current record state.

Comparison draft: bind ordered economy pair, canonical lens/calculation version, instrument mapping, period mode, date cutoffs and source vintages. Input edits invalidate old result and reviewed payload; ignore late responses for old inputs or another account.

Four comparison observations do not replace the original three selected measures or alter their coverage denominator. Validate comparable units/instruments/rights/revisions at both cutoffs. Missing/stale/denied/misaligned data withholds the answer; no zero substitution or invented target-range midpoint.
Persist comparison settings on the same question, not the numerical preview or conclusion. Valid intent with unavailable evidence can still be saved; invalid settings cannot be previewed/saved.

Sign-out clears private previews and blocks writes. Exact-state navigation and EN/ZH behavior must remain equivalent. Use keyboard/touch controls with accessible labels and named return; no hover-only essentials.

Keep 320px and 200% reflow, textual chart values, associated field errors, focus restoration, status announcements, conflict recovery, pending outcome handling, conditional undo and actual browser proof in the builder guide.

Disclosure links require actual separate help frames or existing evidence-ledger destinations. Style and implement them as keyboard/touch controls, retain exact prior state, and provide named return. The text edits alone do not create working navigation.
